verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's NetHSM documents a dedicated test container image for testing and development, separate from production. It also runs a public demo instance that answers the API live, so a user can exercise the API without touching production data. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the test image, published demo-instance credentials, a sandbox for the USB key product line (scope is NetHSM only), and deeper documentation of what the test image changes versus production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The test image is designed for testing and development purposes
Do not use the test image under any circumstances for production data and use cases.
A public demo instance (nethsmdemo.nitrokey.com) also answers the API live
